sup:70530.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Please note our cost context: CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for the time your team has put into it.
Thank you for explaining the cost pressures behind your proposal; we understand the importance of these developments to your pricing. We can offer a longer contract term to support your planning, and our demand forecast for this part is rising. Would a longer term be helpful to you?

Your quote of 2026-09-05 for this part was EUR 412.74 per unit (quote:7300003).
Our bottom-up should-cost estimate for this part is EUR 403.21 per unit (cost:350020).
Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 412.74 (po:4500014465-10, po:4500014417-10, po:4500014351-10).

On this basis we propose: EUR 419.78 per unit, payment 90 days net, 36 months, 4580 units a year.

Could you share your cost breakdown for this part, so we understand the drivers together?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,
Thank you for your e-mail, which we have reviewed internally.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €432.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months.
For your information:
We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part.
The rival quote data you cite does not concern this part or our company.
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
Our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length.
We appreciate your proposal for a 36-month contract, which provides mutual planning security and enables us to offer a revised price of €432.88 per unit.
We have also accepted your requested payment terms of 90 days net to support your requirements.
Regarding your request for a cost breakdown, please understand that our internal calculation structures are strictly confidential and cannot be shared.
Material accounts for about 42 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
Should you require further information, please let us know.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your reply and for the step you have taken; we appreciate it.
We appreciate that you have moved in your latest reply, and understand that your management has frozen price reductions and that a larger price step requires pricing committee approval. We also note your willingness to discuss other terms and understand that your internal cost structure is confidential; our long contract term offers planning security, while our rising demand forecast supports a stable basis for cooperation. Our proposal moves toward you again.

Our forecast for this part is up 10.3% (fc:350020@2026-09).

On this basis we propose: EUR 423.71 per unit, payment 90 days net, 36 months, 4580 units a year.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing
